name: War Horde
description: Get Stuck In: Melee weapons equipped by Orks models from your army have the [SUSTAINED HITS 1] ability.

name: Da Big Hunt
description: Da Hunt Is On: At the start of your Command phase, select an enemy Monster, Vehicle or Character as your Prey. Beast Snaggas can re-roll charges against it and improve the AP of attacks that target it by 1.

name: Kult of Speed
description: Adrenaline Junkies: Speed Freeks units from your army are eligible to shoot and declare a charge in a turn in which they Advanced or Fell Back.

name: Dread Mob
description: Try Dat Button!: When a Mek, Orks Walker or Grots Vehicle unit is selected to shoot or fight, roll a D6 for a random weapon ability, or choose one and gain [HAZARDOUS]. The infamous war cry of the Orks is known and feared throughout the galaxy. When it echoes across the battlefield, bellowed from hundreds or even thousands of greenskin mouths, even the most stalwart warriors fear the onslaught to come. If your Army Faction is ORKS, once per battle, at the start of your Command phase, you can call a Waaagh!. If you do, until the start of your next Command phase, the Waaagh! is active for your army and:Units from your army with this ability are eligible to declare a charge in a turn in which they Advanced. Add 1 to the Strength and Attacks characteristics of melee weapons equipped by models from your army with this ability. Models from your army with this ability have a 5+ invulnerable save.

name: Green Tide
description: Mob Mentality: Boyz units from your army have a 6+ invulnerable save, or a 5+ invulnerable save if they contain 10 or more models.

name: Bully Boyz
description: Da Boss Is Watchin': At the start of your Command phase, if you have a Warboss on the battlefield, you can call a second Waaagh! for Warboss, Nobz and Meganobz units.

name: Taktikal Brigade
description: Lissen 'Ere: Blood Axe leaders can issue Taktiks to nearby Orks units, granting re-rolls to Charge rolls, +1 Strength, Stealth and cover, or +1 to Hit rolls.

name: More Dakka!
description: Dakka! Dakka! Dakka!: Ranged weapons equipped by Orks Infantry and Orks Walker models have [ASSAULT], and gain [SUSTAINED HITS 1] during your Shooting phase while the Waaagh! is active.

name: Freebooter Krew
description: Here Be Loot: At the start of your Command phase, select a loot objective. Orks Infantry, Mounted and Walker attacks have [SUSTAINED HITS 1] while within range of it or when targeting a unit within range of it.

name: Speedwaaagh!
description: Turbo Boostas: Speed Freeks and Trukk units can Advance 24" in a straight line, gaining [ASSAULT] but unable to declare a charge.

name: Blitz Brigade
description: Eager for the Fight: Orks units that disembark from a Transport can re-roll Advance and Charge rolls until the end of the turn.
